whereby respondents application under Section 18 (2) of the Land Acquisition Act has been allowed and petitioner's application has been dismissed as time barred.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner, after referring to impugned order as well as Section 18 (2) of Land Acquisition Act, 1894 and relying upon order dated 26.03.2014 passed in Civil Revision No.430/2009 and Abhay Kumar Jain Vs. State of Madhya Pradesh AIR Online 2022 MP 2378 ,
submits that from impugned order itself it is evident that petitioners were not present on the date of award and notice issued to them is not proper as copy of award is not proved to have been sent with the notice.

sentences.text: It is also urged that Court below has wrongly dismissed petitioner's application by calculating limitation from the date as mentioned in certified copy of award i.e, 14.05.2013.
It is also urged that learned Court below has erred in considering period of limitation as six weeks.
It is urged that in view of the facts of the case, period will be six months from the date of knowledge of award.
4. On above grounds, it is urged that petition be allowed and impugned order be set aside.
5. Learned counsel for the respondent/State submitted that notice under Section 12 (2) has been duly served on petitioner and petitioner has accepted award amount.

sentences.text: Therefore, Court below has rightly dismissed petitioner's application as time barred.
6. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

7. In view of issue involved in the case, it would be appropriate to reproduce Section 18(2) of Land Acquisition Act which reads as follows:-
"(2) The application shall state the ground on which objection to the award is taken:
Provided that every such application shall be made- (a) if the person making it was present or represented before the Collector at the time when he made his award, within six weeks from the date of the Collector's award;
(b) in other cases, within six weeks of the receipt of the notice from the Collector under section 12, sub-section (2), or within six months from the date of the Collector's award, whichever period shall first expire."

8. Now, if impugned order is read alongwith above provision, then it is evident that Court below has clearly held in impugned order that in view of there being no mention in the notice that copy of award was also sent, it cannot be said that petitioner had received copy of award, therefore, it cannot be said that notice was duly served upon petitioner under Section 12 (2) of Land Acquisition Act.
Further, it is also mentioned in the impugned order that from case file, it is clear that on the date of award, petitioner or his Advocate was not present before the competent officer.

9. Perusal of impugned order reveal that Court below has held petitioner's application as time barred on the ground that petitioner received certified copy of award on 14.05.2013 and therefore, if six weeks' period is calculated from 14.05.2013, then, petitioner's application is time barred.

10. In this Court's opinion, perusal of Section 18 (2) (a) reveal that if person filing the application was present before Collector at the time of award, then, applicant would have six weeks' time to file application and as per Section 18 (2) (b), period of six weeks' would be available from receipt of notice under Section 12 (2).
In the instant case, both the above provisions are not applicable in view of impugned order itself and finding recorded by the Court below.

11. In this Courts opinion, in the facts and circumstances of the case, second part of Section 18 (2)
(b) of the Act would be applicable and petitioner was entitled to file application within six months from the date of receipt of certified copy of award i.e, 14.05.2013.
If above period of limitation is taken into consideration, then, clearly petitioner's application is not time barred.

12. Perusal of the application filed by respondent under Section 18 (2) of Land Acquisition Act reveal that respondent has filed above application on sole ground that award has been passed on 25.04.2009 and notice has been duly served on applicant on 02.06.2009 under Section 12.

13.
